title: BenchX observed-context record
description: The shape of one entry in a result's observed_context object (docs/design/runner-schema.md §5.3). observed_context itself stays an open object in schemas/measurement-result/0.1.0; this schema validates that every value in it is an observation record, never a bare value.
$comment: Answers benchmark-environments.md §9 open question 1 (how a fact's source is represented): one record per key, not one provenance map from field path to source. Not referenced by $ref from the result schema, since observed_context has no per-value constraint there (schema §9 open question 4 asks whether it should); a producer or validator applies this schema to coordinates.observed_context directly to check the convention. Not part of the §7 hash table in runner-schema.md: it validates a value shape, not an identity artifact.

value.description: Absent when status is unavailable or error. A sampled, observed record's value is {min, max, mean, n}.

unit.description: UCUM, as in the result schema.

source.description: Where the value came from, such as a sysfs path or a collector name.
